scope: Frozen before/after comparison on the SAME compiled dist/ (same build state, same manifest, same on-disk dist/ bytes). Volatile counters excluded (uptime_ms, last_event_timestamp) — they reflect the call moment, not the payload shape. entrypoint_count is read from the runtime manifest, not hardcoded in any public API description.

contract.default: full — preserves prior shape (entrypoints map populated)
contract.opt_in_summary: verbosity='summary' — omits entrypoints map, keeps every other identity field
contract.diagnostic: get_build_identity — dedicated MCP tool, always returns the full map
contract.server_side_integrity: UNCHANGED — readBuildIdentity() still re-hashes every listed dist/ file on every call regardless of caller verbosity
contract.unknown_verbosity: REJECTED — handler returns an error naming the field and the bad value

notes: DEFAULT is preserved. The opt-in `verbosity=summary` is for routine first-use / consumer probes; explicit full and dedicated get_build_identity serve operators and CI.
